This soup tastes a little bitter.

s.zh: 我在门口就闻到了鸡饭的味。
s.en: I could smell the chicken rice from the door.
What is this smell?
The chicken soup tastes really good.
The snacks here have a special flavour.
Grandma's cooking has a special flavour.
There is a bad smell here, open the window quickly.
My older brother's shoes smell bad.
The little bird is looking for food.
Mum bought a lot of food.
Singapore has lots of good food.

s.zh: 我们去小贩中心吃美食。
s.en: We go to the hawker centre to eat tasty food.
Mum shares the watermelon with us.
The teacher divides us into two groups.
The two puppies don't want to be apart.
Separate the red balls from the white balls.
It is very hot today.
I really like my teacher.
I understood everything the teacher said.
My little brother is still small, he doesn't understand.
You are such a sensible child.
My older sister is sensible and often helps Mum.
I am sick and need to see a doctor.
I want to be a doctor.
He has got better from his illness.
The puppy is sick and doesn't want to eat.
I was sick and didn't go to school.
It is getting cold, don't fall sick.
The doctor is seeing a patient.
Sick people should drink more water.
Mum takes me to see the doctor.
The doctor is examining Grandma.
Dad's car has a small problem.
This lamp has a fault, it keeps flickering.
Grandma is smiling in her hospital bed.
The doctor stands beside the hospital bed.
You need to bring your passport to go overseas.

s.zh: 爸爸找不到他的护照了。
s.en: Dad can't find his passport.
The nurse is very kind.
My older sister is a nurse.
We should take good care of small animals.
We should care for plants and trees.
Big sister takes care of her sick little brother.
I take care of the kitten at home.
There are many customers in the shop.
That customer ordered a cup of tea.
We go to the hawker centre to eat.

s.zh: 那个小贩卖的面好好吃。
s.en: The noodles that hawker sells are so tasty.
Mum teaches me to write.
My older brother teaches me to play ball.
Our classroom is on the second floor.
There is nobody in the classroom.
My mother is a teacher.
Today is Teachers' Day.
Auntie teaches at a school.
Grandpa was a teacher for many years.

s.zh: 爸爸把这个游戏教给了我。
s.en: Dad taught me this game.
I teach this word to my little brother.
This kind of flower smells nice.
I like this kind of biscuit.
There are all kinds of flowers in the park.
I like all kinds of fruit.
I put the seed into the soil.
The seed grew into a little sprout.
This shop has many kinds of biscuits.
Uncle speaks several foreign languages.
Auntie comes to our house to visit.
Auntie gave me a pack of sweets.
Mum is a member of this shop.
Are you a member here?
My older brother is on the football team.
The team members are running on the field.
There was a fire over there.
If you see a fire, make a phone call for help.
The light went out, it is so dark!
Dad put out the fire.
The security guard is at the gate.

s.zh: 保安叔叔帮我找到了书包。
s.en: The security guard helped me find my bag.
We must protect small animals.
We must take good care of our eyes.
The kitten is catching a bug.
My little brother grabbed a handful of sweets.
My little brother is very scared of thunder.
Don't be afraid, I am here.
This story is so scary!
That big dog is so frightening.
I live next to the school.
Grandma lives with us.
Stop, don't run!
The teacher told us to stop where we were.
I caught the ball.
Hold on to my hand, be careful!
The sky is getting cloudy, it is going to rain.
It was cloudy all day, but it did not rain.
Today is a cloudy day.
Bring an umbrella when you go out on cloudy days too.
The sky has cleared, let's go out and play!
Will it be sunny tomorrow?
On sunny days we go to the park.
Today is sunny and very hot.
My shoes are wet.
It rained, and all the clothes got wet.
It is so cold today!
My hands are so cold.
The air con is on in the classroom.
The air con is turned up too high.
Mum tells me not to drink cold water.
I wash my face with cold water.
It is so hot outside!
The soup is very hot, be careful!
Auntie Wang is always happy to help.
He is a helpful classmate.
The room is so dark, turn on the light.
It is getting dark, let's go home.
I am not afraid of the dark.

s.zh: 黑暗里有两只亮亮的眼睛。
s.en: There are two shiny eyes in the dark.
There are lots of dark clouds in the sky.
Dark clouds are coming, it will rain soon.
There is lightning outside, it is scary!
After the lightning came the thunder.
A strong wind is blowing outside.
The strong wind blew my umbrella away!
It is windy today, so it is cold.
The wind is blowing, close the window quickly.

s.zh: 老师说的话，我都记在心里。
s.en: I keep everything the teacher says in my heart.

s.zh: 妈妈把要买的东西记下来。
s.en: Mum writes down the things she needs to buy.
Please remember what I said.
I remember the way home.
My big brother takes notes in class.
I read my big sister's notes.
I came first in the race!
My little brother got a red packet.
I got a new schoolbag.

s.zh: 过年时我得到很多红包。
s.en: I get lots of red packets at New Year.
Do you still remember me?
Remember to bring an umbrella when you go out.

s.zh: 弟弟懂得帮妈妈做事了。
s.en: My little brother now knows to help Mum with chores.
I know to be careful when crossing the road.
All right, stop crying.
That's enough, don't say any more.
Do you really have to go now?
My little brother insists on having that red ball.
It is getting windy, please close the window.
The kitten sits by the window watching birds.
The kitten sits on the windowsill.
Mum puts the flowers on the window ledge.
It is raining, close the window quickly.
There is a tree outside the window.
The window is open and it is very windy.
I watch the rain by the window.
I forgot to bring my schoolbag.
Don't forget to switch off the light.
I forgot to bring an umbrella.
Don't forget to brush your teeth.
Mum is in a hurry to go out.
My little brother was so worried that he cried.
It started raining, so I hurried home.

s.zh: 听到铃声，我急忙跑进课室。
s.en: Hearing the bell, I rushed into the classroom.
Don't worry, I will help you.
I can't find the kitten and I am very worried.

s.zh: 我的自行车上有一个铃。
s.en: My bicycle has a bell.
The school bell has rung.
The bell for class is ringing.
I heard the phone ringing.
The doorbell rang, Dad is back.
Our doorbell is broken.
The phone rang and Mum went to answer it.
The thunder outside is very loud.
There is a very loud noise outside.
I heard a noise upstairs.
I patted the puppy's head.
Grandma stroked my face.
I got soaked by the rain.
It is raining, don't get wet.
Where is Mum? Where did she go?
What are you doing?
I am full. What about him?
You are here. What about him?
I love eating fish. And you?
I am eight years old. How about you?
A little bug is crawling on the ground.
My little brother climbed onto the bed.
Dad and I go hiking up the hill.
Climbing hills is a lot of fun.
Grandma put honey in her tea.
I love eating honey.
There is a bee on the flower.
Careful, there are bees over there!
Tigers live in the jungle.
There are many birds in the jungle.
There are many fish in the pond.

s.zh: 鸭子在池子里游来游去。
s.en: The ducks swim around in the pond.
The toy car's battery has run out.
This battery is new.
A little bird is standing on the branch.
The wind is strong and a branch fell down.
The little rabbit hops around.
I jumped up with joy.
My little sister and I dance together.
My big sister dances beautifully.
My big brother came first in the long jump.
We do the long jump on the field.
I am very good at the high jump.
My big brother is doing the high jump on the field.
The water in this river is very clear.
I can't hear clearly what you are saying.
There is a frog in the pond.
The frogs croak at night.
I am scared of thunder.
Don't be afraid, I am here.
Pests eat the leaves of trees.
Grandpa is looking for pests on the vegetables.
I have something to say.
A lot of things happened today.
My neighbour is very friendly.

s.zh: 阿姨热情地请我们吃饭。
s.en: Auntie warmly invited us to eat.
Mum asks me to go and buy vegetables.
Dad lets me play for a while.
I give up my seat to Grandma on the bus.
The big boy gives his seat to the old man.
My little sister looks like Mum.
This cloud looks like a sheep.
It seems like it is going to rain.
He seems unhappy.
There is a bird's nest in the tree.
The puppy is in its bed.
In the end he did not come.

s.zh: 我等了很久，结果车还没来。
s.en: I waited a long time, but the bus still did not come.
The ending of this book is very good.

s.zh: 故事的结尾，小狗回家了。
s.en: At the end of the story, the puppy went home.
My tooth fell out.
My pen fell on the floor.
Mum takes out the fish bones.
Please remove this word.
I forgot about this matter.

s.zh: 不要忘掉我们是好朋友。
s.en: Don't forget that we are good friends.
The car turns around at the junction.
Dad turns the car around to go home.
The duckling fell behind.
Do not fall behind when we walk.
There is mud on my shoes.
The puppy is playing in the mud.
Flowers should be planted in the soil.
After the rain, the soil is wet.
He cuts the biscuit into two halves.
We split into two teams.
The ice turned into water.
The sky has turned black.
I finished my homework.

s.zh: 我们一起完成了这个游戏。
s.en: We completed this game together.
I want to become a doctor.
They became good friends.
The new school has been built.
This bridge was built last year.
